svg.title: Honeycomb Hills - pointy-top hex slab silhouette reference (attach to every hex prompt)
svg.desc: A regular pointy-top hexagon top face (sharp vertex top and bottom, flat vertical edges left and right), drawn perfectly flat and mirror-symmetric - no tilt, no isometric, no perspective - with a simple darker band below representing the tile's straight side wall, NOT a receding 3D face. Frame 224 x 304: top face upper ~85%, wall band bottom ~15%.
